title: close removes the sprint's own orchestrator and reviewer worktrees once their commits are on main
goal: backlog.py close, or tidy --apply, removes the closing sprint's orchestrator worktree (orch-<sprint>) and its detached reviewer worktree once every commit they hold is on origin/main and they are clean, printing each removal or what keeps one, so finished sprints leave no worktree behind

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='a', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='a@example.com', GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='a', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='a@example.com')
def g(t, *a): return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=t,env=ENV,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
def run(unmerged):
    t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve(); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir()
    (d/'SP-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'active','goal':'g'}))
    g(t,'init','-q','-b','main'); g(t,'add','-A'); g(t,'commit','-q','-m','plan')
    w = t/'.claude'/'worktrees'/'orch-aaaaaaaa'
    g(t,'worktree','add','-q',str(w),'-b','orch/s-aaaaaaaa')
    if unmerged:
        (w/'x.txt').write_text('x'); g(w,'add','-A'); g(w,'commit','-q','-m','unmerged work')
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'close','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return r.returncode, w.exists(), r.stdout
rc1, left1, _ = run(False); rc2, left2, out2 = run(True)
sys.exit(0 if rc1 == 0 and rc2 == 0 and not left1 and left2 and 'kept' in out2 else 1)

notes: SP-wjp5qllo retrospective: git worktree list shows over 50 orch-* worktrees and their nested review-* worktrees from closed sprints (SP-g2ssvhi2's report: 'git worktree remove denied; tidy keeps checked-out branches'); close removes only worker worktrees, so each sprint's orchestrator and reviewer worktrees stay until removed by hand.
